assessments.reasoning: §§7.2.10–7.2.11 route two Number operands to the corresponding Number operation at step 2. In §6.1.6.1.14 steps 2–3 both mixed-sign zero orders return false. The corresponding steps of §6.1.6.1.15 both return true.

challenge.method: Checked both orderings and used a pair of NaNs to distinguish the nearby Number::equal route. Compared §7.2.15 IsStrictlyEqual, §20.1.2.15 Object.is and §23.1.3.16 Array.prototype.includes.
challenge.results: The two Number operations agree on a pair of NaNs and differ on the two signed-zero permutations. Number::equal agrees with Number::sameValueZero on the mixed-zero pairs and rejects a pair of NaNs. The cited consumers select their respective abstract comparisons.

limitations: These step results apply to Number signed zeros. They leave type conversion and the choice of comparison operation to the relevant caller.
